thesis: Cadence is a complete standalone package. The peers of the core and stage-pack blocks live in this repo. Install publishes them. The runtime never reads the content of a host command or skill tree. A gate can lstat and resolve a host entry with a peer's name to find a peer shadow. Config binds another peer to a block (peers.<block> in the config layers).

supporting_commands.why: R4 re-review: a peer reviews the commits since the last reviewed commit and appends a Last reviewed commit line; final_consolidate.py then checks that line against HEAD.
R7 summary: a peer reads the run's manifest and its documents and writes .context/summaries/<task_id>.md; activate_session.py --deactivate closes the run only after that peer write.

P8 and review deferrals: a peer rules GREEN, AMBER or RED on each row of the deferral register against the request and references/deferral-framework.md, from the manifest that P8 writes; P8 and P9 accept a deferral only with a ruling of the register as it is now.
